# awx_notification_template_twilio (Resource)

Manages an AWX `Twilio` (`twilio`) notification template with first-class typed configuration attributes. Equivalent to `awx_notification_template` with `notification_type = "twilio"`, but with per-field schema validation and sensitivity instead of a JSON `notification_configuration` string.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_sid` (String) Account SID.
- `account_token` (String, Sensitive) Account Token.
- `from_number` (String) Source Phone Number.
- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.
- `organization` (Number) Organization this notification template belongs to.
- `to_numbers` (List of String) Destination SMS Numbers.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for this notification template, as a JSON object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID of this notification template.
- `notification_type` (String) AWX notification type, fixed by this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <id>
import {
  to = awx_notification_template_twilio.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <id>
terraform import awx_notification_template_twilio.example 1
```
